Isolation Simulator is a one-person passion project. To be fully transparent:
I recorded all the voice lines myself, then used AI voice filters to create different character voices.
Some background wall art and a few music tracks/instrumentals were created or enhanced with AI tools.
Everything else — gameplay systems, level design, ARG mechanics, most 2D assets, lore, writing, and core experience — was made manually by me.
I used AI only where it helped me focus on what matters most to me: deep storytelling, player observation mechanics, and a complex ARG. I know some players have strong feelings about AI in games — I respect that. This is simply how I was able to finish the game as a solo developer.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

AI was used in the creation of certain visual assets, including character avatars, title screen artwork, promotional materials, and background art. However, these assets still required substantial manual work such as design, sketching, outline drawing, and polishing. The AI was used primarily as a tool for coloring and enhancement, and it did not dictate the creative direction. The visual style remains faithful to the original Little Fighter 2.
Some people assume that because AI was used in certain artwork, it must have been applied throughout the entire project. That is far from the truth. I used AI primarily for large-scale visual tasks. To give a clearer picture: the game includes over 3,000 hand-crafted sprite frames, composed from thousands of hand-drawn body parts. In contrast, only about 100 images were AI-assisted, and many of those, such as promotional artwork, don't even appear in the actual game.
I understand that some people may have concerns about the use of AI in the creative process. But I hope people can see the broader context and appreciate the amount of manual effort that went into making this game. Please know that I’m a solo developer working with a limited budget. I’ve been developing this project for around 3.5 years; even quitting my full-time job for a year to work on it full time, without expecting it to cover even half of my previous salary. I've done my best to balance quality and practicality. Your understanding and support mean a great deal to me.

Our game leverages generative AI during development to create visually rich and immersive environments, character designs, and narrative elements. AI tools have been used to assist in crafting unique pre-rendered assets, such as artwork and animations, ensuring a high-quality experience while adhering to copyright and ethical guidelines.
However, the game does not use AI to generate live content or code during gameplay. All in-game interactions and mechanics are pre-designed and curated by our team, ensuring a consistent and controlled gaming experience.
By incorporating AI responsibly, we aim to deliver a creative and engaging experience while maintaining transparency and safeguarding user trust.

We're just a small team who loves making games and we love using AI to make them even better.
We know there’s been a lot of negativity around AI in games lately, and honestly, we get it. But for us, AI isn’t some big scary thing, it’s a tool we use every day with excitement and care. It helps us bring our world to life, and gives players new ways to express their own creativity.
In our game, AI is used to make things feel more alive. It helps players voice their characters, translate their stories for others to enjoy around the world, and build cool things they might not have been able to otherwise. We're not using AI to replace artists or writers, we're using it to give more people the power to create.
We believe in giving players tools, not walls. AI is one of those tools, and we're constantly working to use it in thoughtful, respectful ways that fit our vision and our values.
So if you're on the fence about AI in games, we just ask: give it a chance. We’re doing our best to make something special here. This game is built with love, and we hope that shows in every part of it, even the parts powered by AI.

At Lovely Bytes, we're not just developers, we're passionate gamers like you. And because we understand the gamer's perspective, we firmly believe that the heart of a truly great game lies in the emotional depth and authenticity that only human creativity can provide.
In the development of UNHEIM, artificial intelligence plays a supporting role to accelerate our production, and is used mindfully to help us with certain time-consuming tasks, such as visual brainstorming, or speeding up the process of creating some of the textures. Additionally, AI bravely tackles the Herculean task of turning our chaotic creative thoughts and wild brainstorming scribbles into something resembling coherent, actionable documents.
Our approach to AI is to use it as a tool to augment our skills and capabilities, not to substitute the craft elements that are crucial for creating a deeply engaging and memorable game experience.
Now go and have fun getting scared to death, knowing that what you experience is the result of a mindful blend of assistive technology and traditional craftsmanship.

This project was initiated in September 2022. As part of an academic exploration of emerging technologies, AI image generation tools (which were still in the early stages of development at the time) were used to assist with the visual processing of certain content, and an AI music generation tool was used in the production of the background music.
To avoid the misuse of generative AI tools, only the default datasets provided by the respective tools were used during development. The methods of use included:
1. Processing real photographs to create "alien" or "distorted" visual effects;
2. Using abstract images generated from provided keywords as references for manual redesign, reconstruction, and painting;
3. Generating atmospheric music clips by adjusting parameters such as instrumentation and tempo, followed by manual editing and refinement.
All content involving artificial intelligence was completed before 2023. Since then, the use of AI image generation technology in development has been fully discontinued and will not continue in future production.
For all AI-generated image assets used in this work, only usage rights are retained by the project.

All in-game content is dynamically generated based on player choices, the selected Game Master persona, and the chosen world framework. Nothing is pre-scripted.
Default experience: The game includes a built-in relay service (enabled by default, no setup required). Players can launch and play immediately. All AI requests are routed through the developer's own server, which applies keyword filtering and progressive moderation on both input and output before forwarding to the AI model. Every player receives a free daily quota.
Monetization: One-time DLC purchases are available through Steam for additional turns beyond the free daily quota. These are single purchases, not subscriptions, priced $1–$10. DLC revenue covers the developer's costs.
Content guardrails: In Relay Mode, all requests pass through server-side multi-layer moderation — keyword filtering (red-line terms blocked immediately; yellow-line terms accumulate toward escalation), bidirectional input/output checks, and progressive restrictions for repeat violations.
